data.long_meaning: Diminutive form of the Irish name Patricius, derived from Latin Patricius meaning 'noble, patrician'. In Ireland, it was common for a diminutive name to be used for a child born into a noble family, but who was not the eldest. The name Paddie carries the meaning “Little Pad” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Paddie usually hope their child will grow to embody little pad and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Thus, the name "Paddie" carries the legacy of this important figure and can serve as a symbol of Irish heritage and pride.
